title: Viva-voce/Interview Notification for the post of Agriculture Development Officer(ADO), Dept. of Agriculture

ARUNACHAL PRADESH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No.PSC-R( A) /14 /2o20:: Dated ltanagar, the 13th April' 2022
NOTIFICATION
In continuation to Commission Result Notification No.
PSC-R(A)/1412020 Dated 7th April'2022, this is to inform all the eligible candidates who
have qualified in the written examination for the post of Agriculture Development Officer
(ADO) , that the Commission has fixed the date of interview/viva voce from 11th May'2022
to l3tt May'2022 atAP PSC Office.
Candidates are directed to upload the self -attested
Xerox Copies of the following documents in Pdf format, not exceeding 1 Mb in size through
their login ID in the Commission's website lyww,app.$q,gQv,in on or before 7th May'2022
from issue of this notification :-
Matriculation Certificate [Class X) issued by Board for proof of Date of Birth.
Class XII Certificates and Mark Sheet.
Degree Certificates and Marks Sheets issued by the Assistant Registrar/Register/
Controller of Examination/Vice Chancellor of the concerned University to ascertain
Educational Qualification.
APST Certificates for APST Candidates, PRC/AADHAAR/EPIC card in case of others,
PwD candidates should submit Disability Certificate obtained from State Medical
Board. Such Board should comprise a specialist of the particular category of
disability for which the certificate is sought for, failing which such certificate will be
rej ected.
NOC from HoD for those who are in regular service.
Candidates may download their Admit card w.e.f Znd
Mav' 2022 onwards from Commission's website www.appsc.gov,in
